news.headline: Delcath amends bylaws to designate Delaware as exclusive litigation forum
news.summary: Board amended and restated the company's bylaws, effective immediately, naming the Delaware Court of Chancery (or Delaware federal district court) as exclusive forum for internal corporate claims and U.S. federal courts for Securities Act claims.

news.headline: Delcath presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference; H.C. Wainwright boosts estimates
news.summary: Management presented to investors in Boston days after the Q2 beat; H.C. Wainwright raised its earnings estimates on Delcath the same week, citing HEPZATO demand momentum.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright raises price target as DCTH shares jump ~22% on earnings beat
news.summary: Following the Q2 report, shares surged roughly 22% to about $15.62 and analysts lifted price targets; H.C. Wainwright reiterated Buy with a raised target, and the stock later marked fresh 52-week highs (~$17.42) through mid-August.

news.headline: Delcath reports Q2 2026 results: revenue beats, FY2026 guidance raised to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue was $29.1M (vs. $24.2M in Q2 2025), including $27.1M of HEPZATO KIT sales, with gross margin of 90% and net income of $2.7M; HEPZATO volume grew ~30% YoY, two new treatment centers were activated (31 total, targeting 37 by year-end), and full-year revenue guidance was raised to $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA expected.

news.headline: Delcath announces date for Second Quarter 2026 earnings call
news.summary: Delcath scheduled its Q2 2026 results conference call for August 6, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET.

news.headline: First patient dosed in Phase 2 DELUMA trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in a global Phase 2 trial (DELUMA) evaluating HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in HER2-negative, liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, extending HEPZATO's pipeline beyond its approved uveal melanoma indication.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results/call; company has been beating and raising guidance in 2026, so continued HEPZATO volume growth and center-count progress will be watched.

catalysts.label: Treatment center network expansion to ~37 active sites
catalysts.detail: Management guided to activating roughly six additional HEPZATO treatment centers in H2 2026, up from 31 active sites as of Q2 2026, a key volume driver.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue guidance of $104M-$108M / positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO KIT volume growth over 2025; continued execution against this raised bar is the key near-term financial catalyst.

catalysts.label: ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid)
catalysts.detail: Major oncology conference where Delcath/investigators have previously presented HEPZATO/CHEMOSAT combination and subgroup data (e.g., CHOPIN trial in 2025); potential venue for new data on combination regimens with checkpoint inhibitors or tebentafusp.

catalysts.label: Pipeline expansion trials: DELUMA (breast cancer) and mCRC Phase 2
catalysts.detail: Phase 2 trials in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer (first patient dosed July 2026) and metastatic colorectal cancer (enrolling since 2025) could expand HEPZATO's addressable market; mCRC trial's hepatic PFS primary endpoint data expected mid-2028, OS late 2028.

catalysts.label: Ex-US/European expansion via CHEMOSAT and guideline inclusion
catalysts.detail: CHEMOSAT was added as a recommended liver-directed regional therapy in the ESMO-EURACAN uveal melanoma clinical practice guidelines (April 2026), supporting continued European reimbursement/adoption momentum.

pulse: Delcath is riding strong momentum after a Q2 2026 earnings beat (revenue $29.1M, up ~20% YoY, 90% gross margin) drove a ~22% single-day stock pop and a raise in full-year revenue guidance to $104M-$108M, with shares hitting fresh 52-week highs near $17-18 through mid-August. HEPZATO KIT volume grew ~30% YoY on center-network expansion (31 active sites, targeting 37 by year-end), and analysts including H.C. Wainwright have been raising price targets and estimates on the back of durable demand despite 340B pricing pressure. Beyond the core uveal melanoma franchise, Delcath is broadening its pipeline with newly dosed Phase 2 trials in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (July 2026) and colorectal cancer, positioning HEPZATO for potential label/indication expansion over the next several years while near-term catalysts center on Q3 earnings, continued site activations, and possible new combination-therapy data at ESMO 2026 in October.
